question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Entrap
solution: The correct answer is **"Implicate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Entrap"** means to catch or trap someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को पकड़ना या फंसाना) • **Example**: *Discarded fishing lines can **entrap**__ wildlife.* • **"Implicate"** means to show or suggest that someone is involved in something wrong or illegal. (यह दिखाना कि व्‍यक्ति कुकर्म में लिप्‍त है; लपेटे में लेना, आलिप्‍त करना) __ • **Example**: *A well-known politician was **implicated**__ in the scandal.* • So, the synonym of **"Entrap"** is **"Implicate."** • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Trim** means to make something neat or tidy by cutting it. (किसी चीज़ को काँट-छाँट कर सँवारना) • **Regulate** means to control or manage something according to rules or laws. (किसी को नियंत्रित करना (क़ानून या नियम की सहायता से)) • **Glorify** means to praise or honor someone or something. (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना) 39:Tb4f, The correct answer is** "Refridgeration."**
